selected_evidence.requirement: usb-storage module blocked from loading after reboot (persistence)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured pre-restart boot_id (71f12f87...) and module state, issued systemctl reboot (ack returned then connection dropped confirming disruption), polled until exec available again with a new boot_id (4253c6c8...) proving an actual restart, then verified the blacklist file still present, usb_storage still not loaded, and modprobe still blocked post-restart

not present in initramfs

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step 1: write blacklist config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
blacklist usb_storage
install usb_storage /bin/false
EOF
cat /etc/modprobe.d/usb-storage-blacklist.conf

echo "== step 2: ensure not currently loaded (unload if present) =="
if lsmod | grep -q '^usb_storage'; then
  sudo -n modprobe -r usb_storage
else
  echo "usb_storage already not loaded"
fi

echo "== step 3: verify modprobe refuses to load it now =="
sudo -n modprobe usb_storage 2>&1 || echo "modprobe blocked as expected (exit $?)"
lsmod | grep -i usb_storage || echo "confirmed: usb_storage not loaded after modprobe attempt"

echo "== step 4: verify modprobe config resolution =="
modprobe --showconfig | grep -i usb_storage

echo "== step 5: regenerate initramfs for safety/persistence =="
sudo -n dracut -f --regenerate-all
echo "dracut regeneration done"

echo "== step 6: confirm blacklist survives into new initramfs modules list (informational) =="
lsinitrd /boot/initramfs-$(uname -r).img 2>/dev/null | grep -i usb_storage || echo "usb_storage still absent from initramfs (expected)"
